perspective:
From Jose Castillo’s perspective:

- He works with Patricia at a community bank, where he sometimes helps with maintenance and repairs.
- He has noticed she seems more withdrawn than usual and remembers her as usually vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay; she said it was “just some personal stuff” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard her on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned he had been reading about financial planning and offered to discuss budgeting tips with her.
- She admitted she had been overwhelmed with her bills and said she would take him up on the offer.
- He worried afterward that he might have overstepped by bringing up finances.
- He clarified to Patricia that he only wanted to help, not pry; she assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend.
- He sensed she appreciated his concern but seemed to prefer handling things privately.
- He has continued to check in with her casually at work, offering support and letting her know he’s available if she needs anything.
- She has thanked him and said it’s great to have his support.
final_response:
From Jose’s perspective, he first offered support by asking if she was okay and offering to listen. Then, after overhearing her worry about bills, he offered financial advice. He later clarified that he only wanted to help, not pry. After sensing she preferred handling things privately, he backed off but remained supportive. Finally, he continued checking in casually and offering support.
